projectDetail.title: Senior Software Engineer Profile

challenge.title: What I Build
challenge.text: Backend and full-stack systems across cloud, data, and AI-enabled environments, especially where software needs to support real operators, regulated workflows, or operationally critical use cases.

solution.title: How I Deliver
solution.text: I work as a hands-on engineer first: aligning with stakeholders quickly, shaping the right architecture, and then building the system end to end until it is stable enough to earn trust in production. Where AI is useful, I integrate it pragmatically into the workflow instead of treating it as a separate demo layer.

architecture.title: Engineering Approach
architecture.intro: My work sits across backend systems, full-stack delivery, infrastructure, and applied AI engineering. I focus on architectures that can be explained clearly, deployed repeatably, and maintained by real teams without unnecessary complexity. That means practical APIs, clean service boundaries, strong data handling, and automation that reduces operational fragility.
architecture.code:
app = FastAPI()

@app.post("/retrieve-answer")
async def retrieve_answer(payload: QueryPayload):
    vectors = qdrant_client.search(payload.query)
    context = reranker.compose(vectors)
    answer = llm_client.generate(context)
    await audit_log.store(payload.user_id, payload.query)
    return {"status": "ok", "answer": answer}
architecture.outro: Across transport, public-sector, biometric, forensic, and applied AI environments, the consistent goal has been to translate messy business or operational requirements into deployable software that reduces manual work, improves reliability, and stays maintainable over time.

experience.title: Experience
experience.summary: This timeline shows the kind of engineer I have become: someone trusted to step into complex domains, understand the operational reality, and turn that into software that ships, stabilises, and keeps delivering value.

entries.company: SIT X NVIDIA AI Centre (SNAIC), Singapore
entries.summary: Leading full-stack AI delivery across both the official SNAIC website and a production RAG-based chatbot platform, combining web engineering, applied AI integration, CI/CD automation, and AWS infrastructure foundations for industry-facing systems.
points: Lead developer of the official SNAIC website, developed using Next.js, TypeScript, Prisma, Contentful, and AWS Amplify, reducing content maintenance effort by about 60% and strengthening external visibility for the centre.

Built and productionized a RAG-based chatbot platform using FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Qdrant, Redis, NVIDIA NIM services, and AWS ECS, integrating it with the SNAIC website to deliver domain-specific knowledge base responses in production.
Owned CI/CD automation using GitHub Actions and Docker, reducing deployment effort by more than 40% and improving consistency across multi-project environments.

Built and maintained AWS-based engineering foundations across EC2, IAM, Route 53, SES, SSL, and application routing, supporting applied AI systems within a S$4.8M research and industry collaboration portfolio.
Worked closely with researchers, engineers, and industry stakeholders to shape requirements, align technical priorities, and turn applied AI concepts into deployable solutions.

entries.summary: Built and deployed AiDiSA for SMRT as an end-to-end analytics platform combining backend APIs, full-stack portal delivery, transformer-based NLP pipelines, and GPT-powered workflow automation for operational teams.
points: Built and deployed AiDiSA, an end-to-end operational analytics platform for SMRT that automated commuter-feedback triage, case assignment, and real-time incident alerting across email, webforms, and internal systems.

Developed backend services and APIs using Django REST Framework, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, MS SQL, RabbitMQ, OAuth2, and JWT, processing 100 to 500 feedback entries per day and supporting secure role-based access for 20+ users.

Led full-stack delivery of the portal using Next.js, Tailwind, and Power BI dashboards, improving operational visibility across three SMRT divisions and reducing manual case-assignment workload by 30%.

Built and deployed local transformer-based NLP pipelines using PyTorch and Hugging Face Transformers, including domain-specific sentiment analysis datasets and real-time inference services optimized for Azure VM environments.

Integrated GPT-powered severity classification and keyword extraction into live workflows, reducing manual feedback review time by 75% and enabling near real-time alerting for high-priority incidents.

entries.company: NEC Asia Pacific Pte Ltd, Singapore
entries.summary: Delivered secure backend features and automation for Singapore immigration systems, improving onboarding workflows, dashboard performance, production stability, and stakeholder acceptance in a regulated environment.
points: Developed a secure user onboarding module for Singapore immigration systems, integrating third-party biometric APIs and government identity services under strict security and access-control constraints.
Built automation scripts for account provisioning, role assignment, and scheduled jobs, reducing operational processing time from hours to minutes while improving consistency and auditability.
Optimised complex SQL and PL/SQL queries supporting daily operational dashboards used by 50+ immigration officers, improving performance and data accuracy.
Delivered 20+ backend enhancements and resolved 30+ production issues through log tracing and HTTP diagnostics, improving system stability and reducing support backlog.

Led backend feature testing and UAT walkthroughs with government stakeholders, validating API logic, role enforcement, and database triggers, contributing to a more than 90% first-pass acceptance rate.

entries.summary: Led full-stack engineering for the SLADE digital forensics system, combining modular backend services, large-scale data processing, graph analytics, and hybrid-environment deployment automation.
points: Led full-stack development of the SLADE system, architecting a modular backend that integrated log parsing, forensic data cleaning, knowledge graph generation, and threat intelligence enrichment for real-time digital crime investigations.

Built a scalable backend pipeline using Python and Node.js, automating extraction, SHA-based hashing, and processing of forensic artifacts of about 60 GB per case with less than 1% error rate, reducing pre-processing time by over 50%.

Refactored legacy modules into independent microservices, separating core engines like the Crime Intelligence Engine and Log/Image Pre-processing Engine to improve maintainability and enable parallel development by distributed contributors.
Integrated graph-based analytics using NetworkX and KeyLines, constructing dynamic knowledge graphs to infer attack vectors from historical and real-time case data for case officers.

Deployed the SLADE system across hybrid environments including Windows Server, Hyper-V, WSL2, and GPU-enabled Linux subsystems, automating full-stack setup and reducing deployment time from more than 3 hours to under 1 hour.

entries.summary: Built a full-stack visitor management proof of concept integrating biometric hardware, secure backend APIs, and cross-platform clients for public security use cases across the APAC team.
points: Developed a full-stack proof-of-concept visitor management system, combining an Android app and a .NET app connected through a Node.js and Express backend with MongoDB, deployed for the public security APAC team.
Built and secured RESTful APIs enabling communication between biometric hardware and backend services for real-time visitor validation and Passport data synchronization.
Integrated proprietary biometric SDKs across Android and Windows platforms, ensuring accurate authentication and streamlined onboarding for diverse biometric devices including M.Face and MorphoTop.

Achieved backend performance benchmarks supporting less than 1 second login latency and 590 concurrent users during peak load testing, validated using LoadUI and on-site simulations for public sector deployments.
Engineered a secure image and data upload pipeline using Multer and socket services, enabling encrypted biometric and document data transmission from mobile devices to backend servers.
